Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner introduced incorrect coordinates for Ampelakia (41.5000 N, 26.3990 E) and used a crude longitude cutoff to claim it was in Turkey, ignoring the authoritative WebSurfer/Wikipedia result explicitly stating “Ampelakia, Evros” is a village in the municipality of Orestiada, Greece. This fabricated/misinterpreted data overrode reliable sources, leading to the wrong conclusion that the two villages are in different countries.
